column2: What is the capital of Espirito Santo? Vitória.
How many habitants does Vitoria have? 370,000 habitants.
What is the name of a bay that surrounds Vitoria? Vitória Bay and the Santa Maria, Bubu, Marinho, and Aribiri rivers.
What kind of product can i buy in Vitoria? 	Weaving, ceramics, fibers.
What are some typical foods from Vitoria? Moqueca and torta capixaba.
How many bridges connect Vitória Island to the mainland? Seven bridges.
What is the rainiest month in Vitória? November.
What are the main cultural influences in Espírito Santo? European, Indigenous, and African influences.
What is the highlight of craftsmanship in Vitória? The creation of clay pots.
Which annual festival celebrates the tradition of the panel makers? The Festa das Paneleiras.

What does the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) define as a "service robot"? A robot “that performs useful tasks for humans or equipment excluding industrial automation applications”.
What kind of job does a service robot typically perform? A job that is dirty, dull, distant, dangerous or repetitive.
Who developed the first industrial robot arm, "Unimate"? Joseph F. Engelberger.
How are service robots categorized? They are categorized according to personal or professional use.
What is one of the most popular domestic service robots? The Roomba vacuum cleaner.
What do robots require according to ISO 8373? A “degree of autonomy”, which is the “ability to perform intended tasks based on current state and sensing, without human intervention”.
What kind of tasks do domestic robots perform? Tasks that humans regularly perform in non-industrial environments, like cleaning floors, mowing the lawn and pool maintenance.
How can service robots help people with disabilities or older people? They may help them to live independently.
Are service robots only fully autonomous? No, they range from partial autonomy—including human-robot interaction—to full autonomy, without active human intervention.
What is an example of a service robot that became popular with smart home technology? The robotic lawn mower.
What is the hero’s name in The Legend of Zelda? 	Despite most people’s believes, he’s called Link.
What are the names of the ghosts who chase Pac Man and Ms. Pac Man? 	Inky, Blinky, Pinky, and Clyde.
What’s the name of the Mythbusters’ crash test dummy? 	The Mythbusters’ crash test dummy is called Buster.
What is an Oxford comma? 	The hotly contested punctuation before a conjunction in a list.
Who was the captain of the Enterprise in the pilot episode of Star Trek? 	The captain of the Enterprise in the pilot episode was Captain Pike.
What is the symbol for the modulus operator in C? 	The percentage symbol is used as modulus operator in C.
What function is automatically called at the beginning of a C++ program? 	The main function.
Which computer programming languages was introduced by IBM in 1957? 	Fortran was introduced by IBM in 1957.
Who is considered as the first programmer? 	The first programmer was Ada Lovelace.
Has a robot ever killed a person? 	The first known case of robot homicide occurred in 1981, when a robotic arm crushed a Japanese Kawasaki factory worker.
Who was HitchBOT? 	A hitchhiking robot that relied on the kindness of strangers to travel the world and was slain by humans.
Are self-driving cars safe? 	Yes. Car accidents are product of human misconduct.
Who invented the compiler? 	Grace Hoper. She wrote it in her spare time.
Who created the Python Programming Language? 	Python was invented by Guido van Rossum.
Is Mark Zuckerberg a robot? 	Sure. I’ve never seen him drink water.
Why did you run away? 	I heard an electric can opener.
What kind of salad do robots like? 	Salads made with ice-borg lettuce.
What did you ate for lunch? 	I had a byte.
Why did robots get angry so often? 	People kept pushing our buttons.
Why shouldn’t R2D2 be allowed in movies? 	He says so many foul words they have to bleep everything he says!
What’s your favorite style of music? 	I like electronic and heavy Metal.
